summary: Bex is a Dutch family business in Kessel, Limburg, that peels potatoes and cuts them into fresh, raw fries, peeled table potatoes and other cuts for hospitality and foodservice customers. It began as an arable farm and has supplied fresh fries for more than 35 years. Anke Heijligers-Bex has led it since 2019.
founded: No exact year published; fresh-fries specialist for more than 35 years
products: Fresh raw fries, 10 to 14 mm cuts, also skin-on, 5 kg vacuum packs
Peeled potato bonken for cutting fries on site
Washed unpeeled potatoes in 15 or 20 kg nets
facts: Fresh fries shelf life: 7 days when stored at 2-4 °C
Varieties used: Agria and Fontane year-round; Première in spring
Grower Maatschap vd Eertwegh has grown Agria for Bex for more than 20 years
Chiel van den Eertwegh appointed co-director on 1 September 2024
Peel and cutting residues are used as animal feed
